items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote code execution via PHP code injection in the template system, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) for this flaw, rated CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could lead to arbitrary code execution, with Adobe confirming active exploitation. A hotfix is available for affected versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, but recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to these updates.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical and important vulnerabilities including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been observed being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation. This was addressed as part of the APSB26-92 security update.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. This issue was resolved in the August 2026 security updates.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass without requiring authentication or administrator privileges. This vulnerability was patched in the August 2026 security updates.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation. This was part of the comprehensive security update APSB26-92.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension. This critical vulnerability could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation. This was included in the August 2026 security updates.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation. This issue was resolved as part of the APSB26-92 security bulletin.
